setup.shared: Updating restarts herdr-core for every app that uses it, such as Herdr; their terminals keep running.
setup.update: Or update it yourself: hc update

install.title: Yuzora needs herdr-core
install.body: herdr-core runs your terminals and agents, and keeps them alive when this window closes. Yuzora couldn't find it on this computer.
install.foot: Install it for me puts it in {place} (with hc), like its own installer: {install}

old.title: Yuzora needs a newer herdr-core
old.body: Yours is {have}; Yuzora needs {need} or newer. {shared}

missing.title: Yuzora needs a newer herdr-core
missing.body: Your herdr-core can't do everything Yuzora needs ({methods}). {shared}

newer.title: This Yuzora is older than your herdr-core
newer.body: Your herdr-core speaks a newer protocol (generation {generation}) than this Yuzora understands (generation {ours}). Another app that shares it, such as Herdr, may have updated it. Update Yuzora; your terminals keep running.

refused.waits: Until then Yuzora stays disconnected; your terminals keep running.

old.title: Update herdr-core to use Yuzora
old.body: It came back as {have}; Yuzora needs {need} or newer (hc update). {waits}

newer.title: Update Yuzora to use this herdr-core
newer.body: Another app such as Herdr moved it to generation {generation}; this Yuzora speaks {ours}. Get a newer Yuzora: {app}. {waits}
